ms.criteria:
(A) Integration
・Investors should be able to onboard to fund via their Cardano Wallets.
・Dashboard has investor addresses from cardano blockchain.

(B) Smart Contracts
・Mentioned smart contracts in output (2) are developed and open-sourced.
・Smart contracts are deployed on cordano testnet.
・Example Token using gating contract template deployed on testnet.

(C) Token Contracts Gating
・Fund managers should be able to add their token contracts deployed on Cardano.
・Investors onboarded to fund should be able to access the on-chain tokens only.
